<color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color>：최대 10중첩까지 적용된다. 매 턴 종료 시 화력 채굴이 <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color> 4중첩을 획득한다. 매 턴 시작 시 <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color>를 <color="#23d4c9">4</color>중첩 이상 보유하고 있을 경우, <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color> 4중첩을 소모하여 <color="#FF7F50">「소각」</color>을 발동하며, HP가 가장 높은 적을 우선 공격한다. <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color>를 <color="#23d4c9">8</color>중첩 이상 보유하고 있을 경우, <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color> <color="#23d4c9">8</color>중첩을 소모하는 것으로 변경되며, 이번에 발동하는 <color="#FF7F50">「소각」</color>의 보호막 수치가 100% 증가한다. 해당 방식으로 <color="#FF7F50">「소각」</color>을 발동할 때마다 자신에게 <color="#FF7F50">「차지 대미지 +20%」</color> 1중첩을 부여하며, 최대 5중첩까지 적용된다. <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color> 4중첩을 소모할 때마다 자신의 오의 포인트를 1 회복한다.
화력 채굴이 전장에 존재할 때, 아군이 <color="#FF7F50">「메아리」</color>를 획득할 때마다 아군 전체가 <color="#FF7F50">「제련의 결실」</color> 1중첩을 획득한다.
<color="#FF7F50">「제련의 결실」</color>：공격력이 <color="#23d4c9">7%</color> 증가하며, 최대 <color="#23d4c9">5</color>중첩까지 적용된다.
target:
增加自身<color="#23d4c9">40%</color>暴擊傷害，火力開採的奧義點數上限+3。
<color="#FF7F50">「迴響」</color>：上限為10層。每回合結束時，火力開採獲得4層<color="#FF7F50">「迴響」</color>；每回合開始時，若持有<color="#23d4c9">4</color>層及以上<color="#FF7F50">「迴響」</color>，消耗4層釋放<color="#FF7F50">「焚毀」</color>，優先攻擊生命值最高的敵方單位；若持有<color="#23d4c9">8</color>層及以上，則改為消耗<color="#23d4c9">8</color>層，本次<color="#FF7F50">「焚毀」</color>的護盾量提升100%。以此方式釋放<color="#FF7F50">「焚毀」</color>時，獲得1層<color="#FF7F50">「蓄勢傷害提升20%」</color>，最高可疊加5層；每消耗4層<color="#FF7F50">「迴響」</color>，回復1點奧義點數。
火力開採在場時，友方每次獲得<color="#FF7F50">「迴響」</color>，全隊均獲得1層<color="#FF7F50">「百煉成金」</color>。
<color="#FF7F50">「百煉成金」</color>：攻擊力提升<color="#23d4c9">7%</color>，最高可疊加<color="#23d4c9">5</color>層。

Each time an ally makes an attack, Poppy gains 1 stack of <color="#23d4c9">Containment</color>. When <color="#23d4c9">Containment</color> reaches 6 or 12 stacks, her Ultimate becomes <color="#23d4c9">Super Pressure Pop</color> or <color="#23d4c9">Hyper Pressure Pop</color>, respectively.
<color="#23d4c9">Containment</color>: Increases the bearer's DEF by 1.5%. Stacks up to 12 times.
<color="#23d4c9">Super Pressure Pop</color>: Deals 235% ATK as <color="#FF7F50">Charged DMG</color> to a single enemy, then discards all "Against the Flow" skill cards, applies <color="#FF7F50">Source Suppression</color> to all allies, and Poppy enters the <color="#FF7F50">Water On</color> state for 2 turns.
<color="#23d4c9">Hyper Pressure Pop</color>: Deals 306% ATK as <color="#FF7F50">Charged DMG</color> to a single enemy, then discards all "Against the Flow" skill cards, applies <color="#FF7F50">Source Suppression</color> to all allies, and Poppy enters the <color="#FF7F50">Water On</color> state for 2 turns. <color="#FF7F50">Source Suppression</color>'s effect now changes to: +50% Counter DMG, +60% Final DMG, and +60% Charged DMG.
